issue_context.title: Allow foreground cascading deletion in kubectl
issue_context.body:
Currently, `kubectl delete` only allows orphaning (`--cascade=false`) or background cascading (`--cascade=true`, the default). There is no option I know to allow foreground cascading deletion. I propose that we maybe do the same thing we did for `--dry-run`, that is, move from a boolean to an enum by accepting `foreground|background|orphan` while keeping compatibility with existing boolean forms.

I know this is a duplicate of another bug, I'll look for it.

/sig cli
/cc @julianvmodesto

review_comments: I think we want a metav1.DeletePropagation here?
I moved `metav1,DeletePropagation` to DeleteOptions. Here we use `string` to get value from Cobra command :)
For review: `foreground` cascading strategy test case is done here.
nit, you don't have to do it here, but `getCascadingStrategy` is not the exact intent, this is more like `parseCascadingFlag`.
@zhouya0 followup nit: don't use `klog`, but rather print directly to stderr
Since other commands use DeleteFlags.ToOptions, is it possible to parse the propagation option here?
I don't think you need this anymore since you don't really care what happens if it's `--cascade`.
Without this, it would complain like `Error: flag needs an argument`
